name: unread-after-failed-assessment
description: An unread Antigravity parent has completed its own turn and assessment has failed. Its Grok child is still in a turn.

name: parked-and-finished-control
description: The parent has unread output and its managed children have finished or parked.

name: working-worker-grandchild
description: A running worker is two levels below its idle grandparent and has an idle immediate parent.

name: working-oracle-grandchild
description: A running oracle is two levels below its idle grandparent and has an idle immediate parent.

name: working-oracle-child
description: An idle parent has a oracle still running its assignment.

name: working-reviewer-grandchild
description: A running reviewer is two levels below its idle grandparent and has an idle immediate parent.

name: working-reviewer-child
description: An idle parent has a reviewer still running its assignment.

name: parked-child-working-grandchild
description: A parked intermediate child still owns a working grandchild.

name: native-running-under-child
description: A managed child owns a native task in progress alongside a completed and a disconnected native task.

name: native-running-under-completed-native
description: An idle owner has a running native grandchild beneath a completed native parent.

name: native-settled-control
description: Retained completed and disconnected native tasks do not keep their owner busy.

name: native-running-direct
description: A running native task is visible while the owner has no foreground turn.

name: monitor-expecting
description: A Claude turn finished and is waiting for a Monitor wake without a tracked background command.

name: monitor-wake
description: A Claude background wake opened a harness turn without a user prompt.

name: background-command-needed
description: An agent left a background process running after its foreground turn. The worker assessed it as needed.

name: background-command-unneeded
description: An agent left a background process running after its foreground turn. The worker assessed it as unneeded.

name: antigravity-native-background
description: Antigravity still reports a native task although the worker published an idle inference from an earlier observation.

name: active-user-shell
description: A user shell command is running after the agent turn ended.

name: held-child-background-process
description: A child completed its handback reminder turn with work processes still alive. Its report is held pending those processes.

name: recorded-handback-control
description: A child completed its handback reminder turn with work processes still alive. A matching report has already been recorded.

name: review-capturing
description: The session has no foreground turn while the review is capturing.

name: review-launching
description: The session has no foreground turn while the review is launching.

name: review-running
description: The session has no foreground turn while the review is running.

name: review-running-stopped-child
description: An idle parent has a stopped managed child with an active review.

name: review-running-stopped-parent
description: The session has no foreground turn while the review is running stopped parent.

name: review-findings
description: The session has no foreground turn while the review is findings.

name: review-clean
description: The session has no foreground turn while the review is clean.

name: review-failed
description: The session has no foreground turn while the review is failed.

name: child-provisioning
description: A managed child is provisioning while its parent worker is idle.

name: child-suspending
description: A managed child is suspending while its parent worker is idle.

name: child-destroying
description: A managed child is destroying while its parent worker is idle.

name: reviewer-child-provisioning
description: A Codex reviewer is provisioning while its DSH parent worker is idle.

name: parent-form-and-working-child
description: An idle parent has a pending approval form while its child works.

name: parent-notification-needs-input
description: An unread parent has a needs input notification while its child works.

name: parent-notification-important
description: An unread parent has a important notification while its child works.

name: parent-failed-and-working-child
description: A parent is failed while its child is still working.

name: parent-unreachable-and-working-child
description: A parent is unreachable while its child is still working.

name: foreground-form-alone
description: An in-flight foreground turn is waiting for an approval form. No process is working in the background.

name: foreground-form-with-background
description: An in-flight foreground turn is waiting for an approval form. An independent command is still running.

name: disconnected-last-known-idle
description: A disconnected worker retains its last materialized execution state.

name: disconnected-last-known-turn
description: A disconnected worker retains its last materialized execution state.

name: server-retry
description: The worker has armed a retry after the provider refused a turn.

name: checking-quota
description: The connected worker has an unsubmitted quota recovery and the daemon publishes its quota check.

name: goal-durable-intent
description: A native goal is active while the harness is between goal turns.

name: cycle-guard
description: Two child relationships form an invalid cycle. Both workers are idle and neither can make itself busy by traversal.
